backend/main.mo: Motoko backend providing Stripe config, user profiles, invoice storage, anonymous event logging, and usage limiting with simple counters and resets.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping feature requirements to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of frontend file paths with short descriptions of each component’s purpose and functionality.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SLUG.md: Documentation defining the required deployment slug format and validation rules for the frontend app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base configuration and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and UI colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining root element and loading the main React script with the app title.
frontend/PRODUCTION_PUBLISH_V4.md: Production deployment checklist covering build steps, validation, security checks, and post-deploy verification.
frontend/PRODUCTION_SMOKE_CHECK.md: Guide for verifying key frontend routes, auth, and Stripe checkout behavior after deployment.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the app router, theme provider, and global layout for all main pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with UI states and retries on auth conflicts.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Collects invoice details, validates mandatory fields, and prepares VAT/legal text before proceeding.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceM: Displays which mandatory invoice fields are complete and highlights missing ones.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceP: Generates invoice HTML, performs risk checks, handles saving and PDF downloading with plan limits.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceR: Shows risk analysis results with critical issues and warnings based on VAT validation.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides global layout with navigation, footer, analytics logging, and consistent app title.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Allows admins to configure Stripe by submitting a secret key and triggers backend setup.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Button that triggers Stripe checkout session creation, logs events, and redirects to the checkout URL.
frontend/src/components/usage/LimitReach: Modal shown when free usage limit is reached, logs CTA impressions, and routes users to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: Upgrade modal showing Starter and Pro plan details with navigation to the upgrade page and CTA logging.
frontend/src/components/usage/UsageLimit: Banner for free users showing remaining monthly invoice quota based on account plan data.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountrySelec: Empty file placeholder for VAT country selection step.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryTrans: Form step for entering VAT-related transaction details, computing VAT rate, validating inputs, and logging events.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryVatDe: Displays VAT rates and features for a selected country with configuration checks and navigation controls.
frontend/src/components/vat/EuVatIntroSt: Intro step listing EU countries and allowing selection before continuing to VAT calculation.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Panel showing standard and simplified VAT explanations with a Pro-gated PDF export option.
Paywall modal for VAT explanations, logging CTA events and linking to the upgrade page.
Renders a horizontal step indicator showing progress with completed, current, and upcoming steps.
frontend/src/components/vat/GlobalDiscla: Displays a small alert stating VAT estimates are informational and not legal advice.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Validates a VAT ID for reverse‑charge eligibility and displays check results with badges while logging successful validations.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: Collects VAT‑related transaction inputs, handles customer type logic, and optionally runs reverse‑charge validation before proceeding.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Shows calculated VAT amounts and scenario‑specific alerts such as reverse charge or exemptions.
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Defines application metadata and validates the deployment slug format at build time.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccountPlan.ts: Fetches the user’s active subscription plan and monthly invoice usage from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnonymousUsage.ts: Tracks anonymous daily usage limits via a fingerprint and provides mutation to increment usage.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Creates a Stripe checkout session through the backend and validates the returned session URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyFingerprint.t: Generates a daily user fingerprint with country detection and exposes availability and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useEventLogger.ts: Logs analytic events using actor, fingerprint, and country data, with optional overrides.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity loading state.
Defines React Query hooks for listing invoices and downloading invoice files through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Handles saving invoices with quota checks based on the user's plan and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Exposes the user’s active plan and derived flags like isPaid, isPro, and isStarter.
Detects the browser’s preferred language and returns it with a simple English check.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks for fetching the caller’s user profile and checking Stripe configuration using React Query.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes along with dropdown utility styles.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/coreEvents.ts: Exports constant identifiers for core analytics events and their type.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/countryDetect: Performs best-effort country detection via ipapi.co, returning country code and IP or null.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/eventLogger.t: Builds and sends structured analytics events to the backend actor with device and page metadata.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/fingerprint.t: Generates and caches a daily SHA-256 fingerprint based on IP, user agent, and date.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/buildInvoiceHtm: Builds a complete HTML invoice using user input, VAT results, translations, and legal text formatting.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getAutoLegalVat: Returns predefined legal VAT text snippets based on the VAT calculation scenario.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/riskCheck.ts: Runs invoice risk checks by validating mandatory fields, VAT legal text requirements, reverse‑charge proof, scenario-specific rules, VAT ID format, and invoice date to produce risks and warnings.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/validateInvoice: Validates required invoice fields based on scenario and returns which fields are missing along with overall pass status.
frontend/src/lib/production/productionMa: Logs a production‑build marker message and exposes it for testing to confirm correct deployment.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Provides a deterministic German‑to‑English word translation utility and a heuristic check for detecting likely German text.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Computes VAT amounts and scenarios based on EU rules, reverse charge, exemptions, and effective rates, with legacy Germany logic included.
frontend/src/lib/vat/euCountryConfig.ts: Defines VAT configuration data for EU countries and provides helpers to retrieve country settings.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Generates detailed human‑readable explanations for various VAT scenarios such as reverse charge, exemption, and digital services.
Provides simplified, child‑friendly explanations of different VAT scenarios.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Defines historical German VAT periods and functions to get current or date-specific rates and compare them with invoice dates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Re-exports core VAT utilities including calculation, explanation, and Germany-specific prompt flow.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Checks whether a transaction triggers OSS relevance based on service type, customer type, and EU cross‑border rules.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Provides system prompts and step‑by‑step instructions for the German VAT calculation flow.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates VAT IDs for reverse‑charge eligibility by checking format, EU membership, and country match.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatCategoryRateRule: Defines VAT categories and computes country‑specific reduced rates for DE, FR, IT, SE, and BE, falling back to standard rates otherwise.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app root with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/CalculatorFlowPage.ts: Implements the multi‑step VAT calculator flow, handling user input, VAT calculation, invoice generation, and explanations.
frontend/src/pages/InvoicesPage.tsx: Lists invoices and supports PDF, ZIP, CSV, and Excel downloads with plan‑based access controls.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Displays the marketing landing page highlighting features, supported countries, and navigation to the VAT calculator.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Displays a payment failure message with retry and home navigation buttons.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows a payment success confirmation, logs the event, refreshes plan data, and provides navigation to calculator or invoices.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Renders upgrade plans and handles Stripe checkout flow, authentication checks, and plan selection logic.
frontend/src/utils/downloadFile.ts: Utility to trigger client-side file downloads for text or binary content using Blob and object URLs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, storing, and persisting URL parameters, including session storage and hash-based parsing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, animations, and plugins for styling.
project_state.json: Stores the current project state, feature list, and pending UI update requests for VAT calculator changes.
